messages: Asha (oncall): :rotating_light: handing off ongoing incident — please read through before taking primary. Root summary: embeddings write path (embed-service -> kv-prefetch) showing increased 5xx and p95 latency in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 since ~00:40UTC. Impact: customer regenerations failing (500s) for ~3% of requests, p95 embedding latency ~5-7s, p99 spikes to ~12s. We've throttled non-critical tenants and partially disabled prefetch in eu-west to stop cascading writes. Current primary: Ben, secondary: Jon. Active alerts: embed-5xx-rate, kv-eviction-rate, primary-p99-latency, regen-error-rate. Links: Grafana panels https://grafana.internal/r/embeds/incident-497531, runbook https://wiki.internal/runbooks/embeddings-kv-eviction. Quick notes below.
